title: Oyo Omulwadde
intro: Edda ennyo, mu nnaku ezaasooka mu byafaayo by’omuntu, emyoyo ebiri gyayimiriranga mu maaso g’Omutonzi waabwe nga giweereddwa ebiweebwayo. Omu yakkirizibwa, omu teyakkirizibwa. Ekyaddirira kyandifuuse ekikangabwa ekinene ekisooka wakati w’abooluganda - ekikolwa kimu eky’okuziyiza obugumiikiriza n’ekikolwa kimu eky’okwesasuza okw’obukambwe. Osobola okubikkula kye ndi?
clues: Nnazaalibwa mu nnaku ezaasooka ennyo ng’omuntu abeera ku nsi
Nnali mwana wa bantu babiri abaasooka ennyo okutambulira ku nsi eno
Lumu nnawaayo ssaddaaka okuva mu kisibo kyange ekisinga obulungi okusanyusa Omutonzi wange
Ekiweebwayo kyange kyakkirizibwa okuva waggulu, ate ekiweebwayo kya muganda wange ne kigaanibwa
Bwe nnatiisibwatiisibwa okuttibwa, nnasalawo obutasitula mukono gwange ku muganda wange
Nnafuuka omuntu asoose mu byafaayo by’omuntu byonna okuttibwa mu bukyamu omulala

location.label: Ekintu Ekikulu
options: Ekinyonyi ekiyitibwa hoopoe nga kitisse obubaka obw’obwakabaka

outcome.label: Ebivudemu
options: Yafuuka omuntu eyasooka okuttibwa mu byafaayo by’omuntu
Yawona amataba amanene munda mu kibya eky’embaawo
Yabeeranga munda mu lubuto lw’ekyennyanja ekinene
Yataayaaya okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu ddungu eddene
outcome.answer: Yafuuka omuntu eyasooka okuttibwa mu byafaayo by’omuntu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
